title: Subsurface Scattering & Organic Translucency
description: Accurate biological light penetration through epidermis, ear cartilage, foliage, or marble, giving natural translucent vitality rather than plastic or wax appearance.

title: Micro-Texture and High-Frequency Fidelity
description: Preservation of microscopic surface details: textile weave, weathered wood grain, polished metallic brushed striations, and delicate facial eyelashes without smoothing artifacts.

title: Optical Aberrations and Real-World Imperfections
description: Subtle natural lens characteristics including gentle peripheral chromatic aberration, natural vignetting, optical diffraction, and sensor noise floor to prevent synthetic artificial sterility.

title: Global Illumination & Radiosity
description: Physically coherent multi-bounce light transport, color bleeding between adjacent surfaces, accurate soft ambient occlusion in crevices, and consistent shadow directionality.
